entities.summary: Archeon in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands, is a living-history park with reconstructed settings, crafts and demonstrations.
entities.description: Archeon in Alphen aan den Rijn presents several historical periods through reconstructed environments and active demonstrations. Crafts bring an element of doing and watching to the visit, so it suits groups interested in how people lived and worked. The broadest supported fit is children around five and older through adults; check current programmes and activity-specific rules.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Archeon in the Netherlands makes several historical periods tangible through reconstructed surroundings, working crafts and demonstrations.

entities.summary: Efteling in Kaatsheuvel, the Netherlands, combines storybook landscapes with indoor themed rides and major theme-park attractions.
entities.description: At Efteling in Kaatsheuvel, landscaped storybook settings accompany indoor rides that carry visitors through themed scenes and larger attractions. The combination works for groups spanning children around four and older through adults, including those who value atmosphere as much as rides. Check current opening and each attraction’s restrictions when planning a mixed-age visit.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Efteling in the Netherlands combines carefully developed storybook surroundings with both immersive indoor rides and larger attractions.

entities.summary: NEMO Science Museum in Amsterdam is a hands-on science centre where visitors explore ideas through experiments.
entities.description: At Amsterdam’s NEMO Science Museum, the attraction is participation: hands-on exhibits let visitors try experiments and repeat them to see what changes. The breadth of activity particularly suits children around five to fourteen who enjoy learning by doing. Check current opening and any activity-specific rules when planning the visit.
entities.whyWorthwhile: NEMO in Amsterdam gives children many ways to explore science by trying and repeating experiments rather than relying only on explanations.

entities.summary: Toverland in Sevenum, the Netherlands, combines imaginative theme-park settings with indoor areas and a varied range of rides.
entities.description: Toverland in Sevenum offers themed environments and a ride mix suited to groups with children around four through the teenage years. Indoor areas help make the visit less dependent on outdoor conditions. Check the current operating calendar and ride restrictions before planning which attractions your group can use.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Toverland in the Netherlands is worth choosing for imaginative surroundings, a varied ride mix and indoor areas that add options in changing weather.

entities.summary: Madurodam in The Hague, the Netherlands, presents the country in miniature alongside interactive visitor activities.
entities.description: At Madurodam in The Hague, small-scale models of the Netherlands are combined with interactive activities. The visit offers more participation than simply looking at a model display, making it a useful choice for children around four to fourteen who enjoy miniature worlds and discovery. Check current opening and activity rules before visiting.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Madurodam in The Hague combines the appeal of a miniature Netherlands with activities that let children take part in the discovery.
